institution: Missouri University of Science and Technology

app_fee.value: The non-refundable application fee is $75 for international applicants.
app_fee.quote: non-refundable application fee of $55 for U.S. citizens and permanent residents or $75 for international applicants

fee_waiver.value: The graduate catalog mentions no application fee waiver; the graduate admissions pages that would say so could not be reached.

gre_general.value: The catalog requires GRE or GMAT only when the academic program requires it, so each program sets its own rule.
gre_general.quote: standardized test scores (GRE or GMAT) if required by your academic program

toefl_min.value: The campus TOEFL minimum is 4.5; the catalog gives no older-scale figure.
toefl_min.quote: The campus minimum for TOEFL scores is 4.5.

ielts_min.value: The minimum overall IELTS band score is 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum acceptable overall band score on the IELTS exam is 6.5.

english_waiver.value: The catalog lists tests and the Pathway Program but no English-medium or India exemption; the exempt-country list was not reachable.

notes: Pearson PTE minimum 58 and Duolingo minimum 115 for campus are on the same catalog page. The ECE department page says the campus TOEFL score is 80 (iBT), which conflicts with the catalog's 4.5; the ECE record carries the department figure. Blocked: futurestudents.mst.edu (graduate, international and application-process pages) and grad.mst.edu return 502; the fee-waiver and English exempt-country rules are on those pages, so those fields stay Not stated. Department subdomains (physics, chem, cs, math, ece, psych) also return 502, so program records use catalog.mst.edu program pages.
